classifier_rubric.assignment_method: Manual, per-session, cited to specific log lines / DB rows during the 2026-07-11 sweep (doc/research/2026-07-11-silent-no-buy-block-registry.md §2-3). This bundle's per_session block re-derives the underlying raw signals (decision-notification presence, buy-scan counters, preflight fail tokens, wash-sale drop lines, sell-only/terminated flags) via the deterministic regex extraction in this repo's sealed script hash below, so the C1-C8 assignments are independently checkable against raw evidence rather than only against narrative description.

classes.C1: Admission/tournament staleness collapse -- n_tournament or admitted-universe count drops sharply (>30% d/d) or a stale_*:live_train_end skip claim exceeds the true retrain cutoff.
classes.C2: Wash-sale mis-stamping / trade-ledger gaps -- last_sell_dates[t] does not match a broker-truth sell fill (±1 trading day), or a broker fill has no corresponding trades-table row.
classes.C3: Config/calibrator fingerprint fail-close -- a fingerprint-parity contract check raises mid-pipeline (not pre-market), forcing a sell-only fallback.
classes.C4: Fundamentals freshness -- serving-axis max feature date lags the session date beyond the model's staleness assumption, silently (no decision-level signal) or via a structurally unsatisfiable freshness gate.
classes.C5: Promote/WF-gate stuck -- a hard preflight fail (P-WF-GATE / P-REGIME-IC / P-RUN-ID / P-CONFIG-FP / P-PANEL-CONTRACT) aborts the full run or forces sell-only fallback.
classes.C6: Threshold-vs-score-scale mismatch -- an active bar (tier threshold, qp_delta_below_min_dw, top_n) sits above the maximum achievable value for every surviving candidate simultaneously.
classes.C7: Whole-funnel single-gate kill -- one gate (veto/regime-admission/sign-launder/panel/vol) kills 100% of candidates that reached it.
classes.C8: Run crash/kill -- the scheduled process terminates (SIGTERM/exception) before reaching the decision-emission phase; no decision notification is produced.

classifier_rubric.note: Descriptive retrospective taxonomy, hand-derived per session from log/DB citations during the 2026-07-11 sweep -- NOT a validated online detector. See doc §5 (descriptive-vs-validated framing) for why the observed 27/56, 67%, 63/22/15% splits must not be read as detector precision/recall.

description: Sealed evidence for the whole-56-session silent no-buy block registry (orchestrator#474): the predeclared population/denominator rule and its verification, the full per-date disposition table (61 cron-fired dates: 56 REAL_SESSION + 5 MARKET_CLOSED, 0 MISSING_LOG), per-session raw signals for all 56 real sessions (decision-notification presence, buy-scan counters, preflight-fail tokens, wash-sale drop lines, sell-only/terminated flags, each with its source log's sha256), the C1-C8 classifier rubric (versioned, descriptive not validated), the per-invariant (I1-I10) online-identifiability assessment, and fresh broker-truth evidence for the GE/HON/EQIX wash-sale mis-stamp correction.
extraction_method: Deterministic Python regex/SQL extraction (sha256 of the extraction script itself is recorded below for reproducibility) against logs/daily_104/*.log (bare-filename canonical logs only; suffixed manual/shadow/experiment logs excluded) and data/runs.alpaca.db (opened immutable=1, read-only) in the live umbrella tree, plus a fresh read-only Alpaca TradingClient query for GE/HON/EQIX. No production path written; no order touched; no git operation in the live umbrella tree.

ge_hon_eqix_broker_evidence.query_method: Direct read-only TradingClient.get_orders(GetOrdersRequest(status=QueryOrderStatus.ALL, symbols=[...], limit=500)), filtered to status=filled AND side=sell specifically (lesson from the GE 05-18-vs-06-01 canceled-order mistake caught during the live-state correction).
ge_hon_eqix_broker_evidence.supersedes_note: The original doc (pre-fix) and this bundle's earlier draft cited GE's broker-truth last sell as 2026-05-18; that was a CANCELED order, never filled. The correct value, confirmed twice (2026-07-11 live-state-correction session and this fresh re-query), is 2026-06-01.

I1.note: n_admitted/n_universe and n_tournament d/d delta are both computable pre-decision, same session, no hindsight.

I10.note: Composite of I1-I9; online-identifiable to the extent each component is, EXCEPT it inherits I9's caveat: if the run never starts or never finishes, no in-pipeline capability bill can be emitted -- the outer watchdog is a structural prerequisite for I10 to ever be assigned on a C8 session, not an optional enhancement.

I2.note: Requires a same-day broker fill-date fetch (already implemented as an STATE-EXT-SELL side lookup) compared against the stamp -- computable at stamp-write time.

I3.note: Needs the trades ledger write to happen synchronously with the broker fill event; the 05-26->06-05 ledger gap shows this durability is not currently guaranteed, so the invariant can only assert on ledger rows that exist -- a ledger-write failure is itself unobservable to this check without an independent broker reconciliation pass.

I4.note: Fingerprint parity (scorer/calibrator/config hash) is a pure function of already-loaded artifacts; assertable as a preflight before the pipeline runs, not just detectable after a mid-run raise.

I5.note: Serving-axis max date is known at feature-load time; the derivative (day-over-day staleness growth) needs one prior session's value persisted, which the funnel-integrity task's own state carries -- online with a 1-session memory, not hindsight.

I6.note: A consecutive-dead-session counter is a running online statistic by construction (each session only needs to know its own capability state plus the prior count).

I7.note: Max-achievable mu/er/qp_delta across candidates vs. the active bar is computable from the same-session candidate set before the decision is emitted.

I8.note: Kill-rate per gate is computable from the same-session funnel counters; the 3-session 80% variant needs a short rolling window (already-available prior sessions), not future information.

I9.note: A heartbeat (exactly one completed run + notification per NYSE session) is checkable by an external watchdog independent of the run's own internal state -- the C8 case (2026-06-05) is precisely the scenario where the run itself cannot self-report, so this must be an EXTERNAL cron/watchdog check, not a check embedded inside the pipeline.
